about: The text rule of Support's docs/contracts/submissions.md, as Kyle ruled Support #17 decision 6 on 2026-09-27, and the cases both sides answer alike: backend/tests/test_submission_text_rule.py reads this file, frontend/src/features/submissions/submissions.test.tsx reads it. `refused` names the first hidden character by code point and place, counting code points from 1 (a plain emoji is one), or is `blank` where nothing is left once whitespace and the joiners U+200C and U+200D go (Support #27): the server refuses such a value in its blank sentence, and the dialog sends such a typed field as absent. `said`, where present, is the whole sentence, the same from the server and on the page.

cases.why: a ZWJ emoji sequence: U+200D is text
a ZWJ sequence with U+FE0F (a mark, not a format character), in a name
Persian, with U+200C inside a word
the joiners are text in every text field
newline and tab, in text
a no-break space (a space, Zs) and private use (Apple's logo) are text
a joiner inside real text stays text

cases.said: text has U+200B at character 10, which a case cannot carry: no format character but the joiners U+200C and U+200D, no unpaired surrogate, no line or paragraph separator, and no control character but newline and tab. Delete it, then preview.
cases.why: zero-width space
right-to-left override; the emoji before it is one character
line separator
paragraph separator
an unpaired surrogate, as a JSON escape delivers it

cases.said: bundle_id has U+DC00 at character 12, which a case cannot carry: no format character but the joiners U+200C and U+200D, no unpaired surrogate, no line or paragraph separator, and no control character. It comes from the inventory, so this build cannot be sent.
cases.why: an unpaired low surrogate
a control character
carriage return: of the controls, text keeps newline and tab only

cases.said: contact has U+000A at character 14, which a case cannot carry: no format character but the joiners U+200C and U+200D, no unpaired surrogate, no line or paragraph separator, and no control character. Delete it, then preview.
cases.why: newline outside text
tab outside text

cases.said: app_name has U+200E at character 1, which a case cannot carry: no format character but the joiners U+200C and U+200D, no unpaired surrogate, no line or paragraph separator, and no control character. It comes from the inventory, so this build cannot be sent.
cases.why: a left-to-right mark leading a name
soft hyphen, a format character
tag characters, even inside a flag sequence
zero-width no-break space
a joiner alone shows nothing, so it is blank
joiners with a line break and a space
a joiner between spaces
both joiners and nothing else, in a name
a joiner and an ideographic space (a space, Zs)
a line separator among joiners is named first, never taken for blank
